title: Simplify makes the direct call in the wrapper of a function with an optional argument indirect
summary: The wrapper made for a function with an optional argument (also for `[@unboxable]`) calls the inner function directly before Simplify and through the closure after it, at the default level, `-O2` and `-O3`. So `[@zero_alloc]` on such a function fails with `called function may allocate (indirect tailcall)`; with `-flambda2-simplify-stubs` the call stays direct and the check passes.

actual.text: The zero_alloc check fails: `Error: called function may allocate (indirect tailcall)`.

cause: A stub is simplified apart from its set of closures (`middle_end/flambda2/simplify/simplify_static_const.ml`), and the code id of its callee is among `code_ids_never_simplified`, so the direct call is not kept.
reference: related: PR #2745 (merged; it followed PR #2663, reverted) makes such calls indirect on purpose
